Entry.Notes: Info on how to unlock each title for Mel https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Cress_Albane:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: アルベイン流剣術の継承者、でもまだまだ見習い中。 素質はばっちり、旅で得た剣の腕もしっかりきっかり
Entry.EnglishText: He's the heir to the Alvein Style, though he's still very much an apprentice. He has talent in spades, and the sword skills he gained by traveling are reliable.
Entry.Notes: Need to double check how we translated Alvein school of sword fighting.

Entry.JapaneseText: エターナルソードを手に、魔王を倒した戦士が 与えられた誇り高きこの呼び名。少しだけ重荷
Entry.EnglishText: With the Eternal Sword in hand, he earned this title by defeating the Demon King. However, it comes with its fair share of burdens.
Entry.Notes: Need help translating second sentence to be more natural

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル３０、仲間と背中を預け合い戦ったあの日々の 感触が腕によみがえる。熱い闘志ふたたび
Entry.EnglishText: At level 30, the feelings of those bygone days from trusting and fighting alongside his comrades have returned. Rekindle that fighting spirit!

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル５０、剣を自分の手のように操れる戦いの匠。 しなやかな剣の閃きはまるで、あでやかな舞いのよう
Entry.EnglishText: At level 50, he is able to wield the sword as if it were his own hand. Watching his swordsmanship is like watching a graceful dance.

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル８０、戦う意味もそのコツも、すべてキレイに 見通す悟りの境地。窮極の剣士
Entry.EnglishText: At level 80, he has reached the stage of understanding the full essence and strategy of combat. He is the ultimate fencer.

Entry.JapaneseText: 少年の申し出を、やわらかく受け入れた心優しき剣士。 本音を出せない優しさがある
Entry.EnglishText: The kind-hearted swordsman tenderly accepted the young boy's offer. His kindness prevents him from expressing his true feelings.
Entry.Notes: Might need a better way to describe "tenderly accepted"

Entry.JapaneseText: 困った時には頼りになる旅の先輩。この世界のことを 知り尽くして、ちゃんと応えてくれる協力者
Entry.EnglishText: He's a reliable travel companion to have when in trouble and an experienced confidant who provides sounds advice.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界の危機を再び救うためにやって来た、かつての 英雄剣士は今もまた健在。いざ悪を打倒せんと進まん
Entry.EnglishText: The legendary swordsman who once saved the world still stands strong. He now moves forward to vanquish evil once more.

Entry.JapaneseText: 多くの奥義を窮め、相当の経験を積む。そして今また、 その努力の結晶は後代に引き継がれようとしている
Entry.EnglishText: Mastering the secret artes and honing his skills through experience, the fruits of his labor are ready to be passed down to future generations.

Entry.JapaneseText: たったひとりで１００コンボ達成！ 桁外れのすごさ。 できる男はやっぱり違う。能ある鷹は爪隠す
Entry.EnglishText: He landed a 100-hit combo all by himself! What a display of skill! A man of this caliber is truly the real deal. The skilled hawk hides its talons.
Entry.Notes: 能ある鷹は爪隠す is an idiom for a modest/humble person who hides their capability until necessary. A Latin equivalent would be "Stilled waters run deep".
Event: Fight 256 battles on Hard difficulty or higher

Entry.JapaneseText: 北で南で戦い連ね、西から東へ伝えられる勝利の噂。 道の先はまだまだ強者が待ち構える。油断すべからず
Entry.EnglishText: As you continue to battle, rumors of your victories have spread all over. But the road ahead is still fraught with formidable foes. Don't let your guard down.
Entry.Notes: Needs context for when he gets the title. Pegi:I added the context to the name of the title. Ignored the North to South and East to West part, but may need to revise this to include those parts

Entry.JapaneseText: ちぎっては投げ、ちぎっては投げ、涼しげな目もとに 浮かぶ余裕がこにくらしい、闘技場のナンバーワン！
Entry.EnglishText: Even as he shreds and tosses his foes, there remains a cool composure in his eyes, a confidence that's maddening. This is the coliseum's champion!
Entry.Notes: Need to double check this one; not sure if it's maddening

Entry.JapaneseText: 重ねた鍛錬の成果が、輝くばかりに艶々しい腹筋。 試しに指を突っ込んで、挟まれて抜けなくなったとか
Entry.EnglishText: These are the fruits of relentless training - abs that shine with a glister. Supposedly, if you try sticking your fingers in, they'll remain trapped.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界に散らばるイシュタル伝説の勇敢な英雄の名。 黄金の武器を集めた君は、もう英雄同然、勝利目前！
Entry.EnglishText: It is the name of the hero who scattered the legends of Ishtar across the world. Having gathered all the weapons, you are already a hero in all but name. The title is within reach!

Entry.JapaneseText: その昔、マッハ少年を脚力で降したその栄誉ある称号。 今もその脚力は健在？？
Entry.EnglishText: Long ago, he claimed this title by defeating the Mach Boy with his sheer leg strength. Does that strength still dwell within him today?
